name: Auto Frame Window
description: Measures every input's frame window automatically by replaying your bot macro.

max-shift.name: Max frames to test
max-shift.description: How many frames early and late each input is tested. Windows at the cap are marked as capped (could be bigger).

horizon.name: Frames to survive after input
horizon.description: A shifted input only counts if you survive this many frames after it. 240 = 1 second. Raise it if a late death caused by an earlier click gets missed.

measure-releases.name: Measure releases too
measure-releases.description: Also measure when you let go (matters for ship, wave, swing holds). Takes about twice as long.

frame-source.name: Frame counting
frame-source.description: How the macro's frames are matched to the game. Auto tries each option and picks the one where the macro beats the level.

frame-budget.name: Speed (ms per frame)
frame-budget.description: Milliseconds of simulation per rendered frame. Higher = faster but choppier screen.

show-markers.name: Show click markers
show-markers.description: Pop a colored circle with the frame window where each click happens (needs a measured level).

show-hud.name: Show window HUD
show-hud.description: Top-right counter of 1f / 2f / 3f / 4f+ clicks so far (needs a measured level). Applies on next level load.

show-next.name: Show next click
show-next.description: Adds a line to the HUD with the next click's window and how many frames away it is.

marker-detail.name: Marker detail
marker-detail.description: Show how many frames early / late each click can be under its marker, e.g. -1 +0.

section-start.name: Section start %
section-start.description: Only measure clicks from this % of the macro onward. Results merge with what's already saved, so long levels can be done in chunks.

section-end.name: Section end %
section-end.description: Only measure clicks up to this % of the macro.
